newsitems.title: SACRATA Steam Playtest Is Now Live!
newsitems.author: 狗骑士
newsitems.contents: Hello, everyone!After continued development, polishing, and optimization, the SACRATA Steam Playtest is officially live!Choose your favorite Goddess and step onto a battlefield where darkness and endless monster hordes collide. Collect gear and Relics, combine skills, create your own build, and take on powerful elite enemies and bosses.How to JoinVisit the SACRATA Steam Store page and click the green “Request Access” button to join the playtest and download the game.The playtest will run for at least 7 days.What’s Included in This PlaytestAll content takes approximately 3 hours to unlock.10 map exploration events7 elite enemies and bosses30+ skills and their evolution effects50+ Relics300+ pieces of equipment60+ achievements20+ skill synergies and build pathsYour Feedback MattersThis playtest is not only an early chance to experience the game—it is also an opportunity for us to improve SACRATA together with the community.We would greatly appreciate it if you could share your thoughts through the feedback survey.Known Game Launch Issues and A SolutionIf you encounter the error shown above when launching the game, please turn off Smart App Control in Windows Settings.Windows Settings > Privacy & security > App & browser control > Smart App Control > OffThank you to every player who joins the playtest, supports us, and has been with SACRATA on this journey.— The SACRATA Team

newsitems.title: SACRATA Steam Playtest Sign-Ups Are Now Open!
newsitems.author: 乔乔
newsitems.contents: Hello, Arbiters!Over the past year, we’ve been hard at work refining SACRATA — improving combat, loot hunting, builds, and character presentation.We’re now ready to welcome our first players to the playtest. Choose your goddess, battle through endless hordes, collect powerful gear, create your own build, and challenge deadly bosses.How to JoinVisit the SACRATA Steam store page and click “Request Access” to sign up.Playtest ScheduleThe playtest is expected to begin in early October.What to ExpectAround a 3-hour experience to unlock everything 10 map events, 7 elite enemies & bosses, 30+ skills & variants, 50+ relics, 300+ pieces of gear, 60+ achievements, 20+ skill synergies…Fight through massive monster hordes and defeat powerful bossesHunt for loot that changes your stats, skills, and playstyleBuild your character through talents, upgrades, and gear affixesPlay as unique goddesses and create devastating combinationsYour feedback is essential to usJoin our Discord to talk with us: https://discord.gg/FWREFjNeEwChoose your goddess, step into the darkness, and begin your loot-hunting journey.The SACRATA Team

newsitems.title: DarkFallen Survivor is Officially Renamed to SACRATA — Development Update
newsitems.author: 乔乔
newsitems.contents: Hello everyone,We know we've been quiet for a while, but we've been hard at work—and today we're excited to finally share what we've been cooking up. The game has officially entered its final development sprint, and we'll be posting updates more frequently from now on. Your feedback is always welcome, and we read every single comment.We have three important announcements today: our game has a new name, development has made significant progress, and our second playtest is approaching.The New NameOur original title, DarkFallen Survivor, is now officially SACRATA.The new name reflects the game’s world and its central idea: survivors are not defined by what they have lost. When we take up arms, we step beyond the role of victims and choose our own path through a world shaped by sacrifice, faith, and judgment.Development ProgressOver the past year, our team has focused heavily on polishing the core gameplay loop and deepening our systems. From meta-progression to the heat of in-match combat, the entire experience is now fully connected and playable. Compared to our very first playtest, both the volume of content and the overall polish of the game have seen massive upgrades:Dual-Loop Integration: Seamlessly connects fast-paced, satisfying in-run mowing mechanics with deep out-of-run progression. The Echo Hall, Gear Forging, and Talent Activation ensure that every victory and defeat yields rewards.Exploratory Random Open World: A randomly generated seamless open world scattered with treasure chests, relic rooms, shrines, blood springs, resource nodes, and special events. The deeper you explore, the faster you grow.Multi-Build System: Freely combine divine skills, relics, runes, and tokens into diverse playstyles to carve a path through overwhelming waves of monsters.Playtest 2 TeaserOur second playtest is just around the corner! This test will offer significantly more content than our first one, covering the full spectrum of both the in-match action and out-of-match progression. We never left—we've just been keeping our heads down to push the game forward.We sincerely invite all of you to sign up for Playtest 2. Every single piece of feedback you provide is crucial in guiding our optimization. Full details and dates for the test will be announced very soon.Join UsIf you haven't checked out our Steam page yet, please consider adding us to your Wishlist and following the game. All major updates will be posted here first!Discord: https://discord.gg/ztdWN3AbFRThank you all for your continued support and patience!SACRATA Dev Team

newsitems.title: Early Playtest Registration Closed
newsitems.author: superlimbergaming
newsitems.contents: Dear players,Greetings to all!Thank you for your continued attention and support for our game! We’re currently in the early testing phase, and over 3,000 players have already signed up to participate. We sincerely appreciate your enthusiasm and valuable feedback!During this testing period, we've received numerous key issues and optimization suggestions. In order to better focus on polishing and improving the game, we’ve decided to pause new invitations for this round of testing and fully dedicate our efforts to developing a more stable and complete demo version.We expect to launch the official demo around October, which will be open to all players—no registration required. Please stay tuned to our community announcements for the latest updates!Thank you once again for your support and understanding. We look forward to seeing you in the official demo!— The Darkfallen Survivors Development Team

newsitems.title: Early playtest keys will be distributed on June 14th (PDT).
newsitems.author: superlimbergaming
newsitems.contents: Dear players, We would like to inform you that Steam keys for the early playtest will now be distributed starting around noon (PDT) on June 14th to those who registered through Discord. Please kindly keep an eye on your Discord direct messages. Our original plan was to distribute the keys on June 13th. In order to meet this goal, our team has been working around the clock for the past few weeks—literally without any days off—pushing forward at full speed to prepare the early playtest build. Despite our utmost efforts, we were unfortunately unable to complete everything in time. The good news is that the build has already been uploaded to Steam and has passed our stability testing. However, a few remaining tasks still require polishing to ensure a smooth experience for all participants. We sincerely apologize for the one-day delay and truly appreciate your understanding, patience, and continued support. Your enthusiasm means the world to us, and we are doing everything we can to deliver the best possible experience.Thank you once again for your kind attention.（The game is currently in its early invitation-only playtest phase.） --Darkfallen Survivors Dev

newsitems.title: Early Playtest Set for June 13
newsitems.author: superlimbergaming
newsitems.contents: Hi everyone, Thank you so much for your continued support and excitement around the demo. We’ve wrapped up the core content and completed several rounds of internal testing. However, based on your feedback, we’ve identified areas—particularly around interactions and audio—that still need refinement. To make sure the experience lives up to expectations, we’ve decided to take two more weeks to polish things further. We know delays are never fun, but we believe it’s worth taking the time to deliver something truly great—not just “good enough.” We really appreciate your patience and understanding. Your support motivates us every day, and we’re doing our best to make that wait worthwhile. We’ll be sharing new demo footage later this week to keep you in the loop. Thanks again—and we can’t wait to share more with you soon! 🕹️About the Early playtest What’s included in the current demo: Playable heroine with mastery over powerful magic Face off against the first boss Unlock both Fire and Ice skills and builds Loot gear all the way up to Mythic-tier rarity Discover unique builds—gear and skills interact to unlock new playstyles. Playtest availability: The early playtest will continue to be updated until we’re ready to release the official public demo. (Note: playtest updates are heavily driven by player feedback, so expect frequent changes to gear, skills, and progression. Save data may be wiped between versions.) Playtest goals: Test the game loop (visuals, audio, controls, difficulty, character and gear progression, etc.); Identify bugs that may appear at scale (crashes, lag, lost items, etc.). You’re the perfect fit if you: Are open to playing an unfinished version and willing to tolerate instability while providing honest feedback; Use OBS or similar tools to record gameplay or bugs and share them with our team/community. How to Join： 1️⃣ Add to Your Steam Wishlist! 2️⃣ Join our Discord 3️⃣ DM the admin your Steam Friend Code (Profile → "Add Friend" → Friend code) (You'll receive the @PlayTester role upon approval) {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45515355/c415580b363664ed167cccb4ca044fade32718a9.png We’re incredibly grateful for players like you. -Darkfallen Dev

newsitems.title: Playtest Delay – Thank You for Your Patience!
newsitems.author: superlimbergaming
newsitems.contents: To Our Anticipated Survivors, We want to thank all our anticipated Survivors for your patience. Our original goal was to launch the playtest in mid-May, but to ensure a smoother and more polished experience, we’re pushing it back just a bit — to the end of the month. The build is nearly ready, with only a few final bugs left to squash. Thank you for your patience and understanding. We can’t wait for you to experience the game once everything is polished and ready for you to dive in! ▌What’s in the Early Playtest Playable heroine with mastery over powerful magic Face off against the first boss Unlock both Fire and Ice skills and builds Loot gear all the way up to Mythic-tier rarity ▌Development Roadmap ▶ Free Demo (Coming Soon) Explore randomized maps with events, destructible objects, hidden treasures, and relics Add Lightning skills and synergy combos Loot up to equip gear Unlock the Talent System for custom builds Encounter new enemies and bosses Discover Ultimate Skills Customize difficulty with scalable challenge levels ▶ Early Access Launch New Playable Classes: Warrior & Hunter Introduce new skill categories: Curse, Holy, and Shadow Unlock crafting mechanics and equipment upgrading Discover and equip powerful Relics Loot Unique-tier gear and chase top builds More difficulty modes and an Endless Survival mode Expand map content and random events Summoning system and combat-ready pet companions ▌Playtest Goals 1.Evaluate whether the game loop is well-designed (graphics, music, controls, difficulty, skills, equipment progression, etc.) 2.Identify potential bugs that may arise during large-scale testing (crashes, lag, item loss, etc.) To those willing to brave this unstable build: 1.Be patient with possible instability and provide honest feedback. 2.Understand that content is still being updated, so please be patient with incomplete features. 3.Use tools like OBS to record gameplay or any bug encounters and share the clips with the group. We sincerely apologize again for the delayed release. - Dev Team

newsitems.title: [Important Announcement] Game Rename
newsitems.author: superlimbergaming
newsitems.contents: Dear Community, We’re updating our game’s title from "Vanyar Survivors" to "Darkfallen Survivors" to avoid potential trademark conflicts. Key Notes: This is only a name change – all planned content and features remain the same. The game’s release timeline and development progress are unaffected. We appreciate your support as we prepare for launch! For updates, join our Discord . — SuperLimber Gaming
